businessLanding.metaTitle: List your business — 3 months free, no commission
businessLanding.heroTitle: Get booked for weddings, henna nights and every celebration in between
businessLanding.heroBody: List your venue, catering or act on Bizim Event. Customers reach you directly, you keep every penny of the booking, and the first 3 months are free.
businessLanding.priceNote: Then £6 a month or £60 a year. Cancel anytime.
businessLanding.calcBody: Many marketplaces take a cut of every booking. We charge one flat fee instead.
businessLanding.calcFootnote: Illustration only. Commission rates vary by platform.
businessLanding.whoTitle: Made for three kinds of business
businessLanding.whoVenue: Wedding halls, banquet suites, gardens, restaurants and community centres — each space gets its own page with capacity, prices and photos.
businessLanding.whoCaterer: Turkish, Kurdish, Cypriot and Black Sea kitchens; mangal, döner and köfte stations, meze, baklava and lokma.
businessLanding.whoPerformer: Wedding bands, davul-zurna, saz, halay groups, DJs, dancers, MCs and henna-night organisers.
businessLanding.how1Body: Add your details, photos and prices in Turkish, English or both. It takes about 15 minutes.
businessLanding.how2Body: Every business is reviewed by a person before it goes live, usually within 2 business days.
businessLanding.how3Body: Enquiries arrive in your inbox. You chat, send offers and confirm bookings — payment goes straight to you.
businessLanding.pricingFreeBody: Your trial starts the day we approve your business. No card needed.
businessLanding.pricingNoCommission: No commission on any booking, ever.
businessLanding.faq1q: Do you take a cut of my bookings?
businessLanding.faq1a: No. Customers pay you directly — deposit and balance — however you normally take payment. We only charge the flat subscription.
businessLanding.faq2q: Can I list several halls or packages?
businessLanding.faq2a: Yes. One business page can hold several listings — for example a main hall, a garden and a VIP room, or a buffet and a mangal package.
businessLanding.faq3q: I'm not in the UK. Can I join?
businessLanding.faq3a: Yes. Businesses in any country can list and set prices in their own currency. The subscription is billed in pounds.
businessLanding.faq4q: What happens after the free months?
businessLanding.faq4a: We remind you before the trial ends. If you don't subscribe, your listings are hidden — never deleted — and come back the moment you do.
businessLanding.faq5q: Do I need to write everything in two languages?
businessLanding.faq5a: No — one language is enough. Customers see the other language as a fallback, and you can add a translation whenever you like.
businessLanding.finalBody: Start now, save as you go, and submit when everything looks right.

intros.info: This is what customers see first. Write in Turkish, English or both — one language is enough to start.
intros.location: Search for your address. Customers see the area on a map; the exact address is shown for venues only.
intros.currency: We filled these in from your address. Prices on your listings are shown in this currency.
intros.listing_venue: Describe the space customers can book. Have several halls? Add the others after this one.
intros.listing_caterer: Describe your catering service. You can add more packages as separate listings later.
intros.listing_performer: Describe your act. You can add other acts as separate listings later.
intros.photos: Good photos get more enquiries. Add at least {min}; the first one is your cover photo.
intros.pricing: Show a starting price so customers know what to expect. You'll send exact offers in chat.

intros.cancellation: Shown on your listing and on every offer. Refunds are handled between you and the customer.
intros.review: Check the list below, then send your business for review.
